# Hand-written (not autogenerated by bazel_to_cmake.py):
# Establish the package-namespace root for the whole overlay tree
# before descending into it.
# See also .bazel_to_cmake.cfg.py's CustomTargetConverter._HEXAGON_MLIR_PREFIX
# comment for how targets under qcom_hexagon_backend/ resolve to
# "hexagon_mlir[::<relpath>]" CMake namespaces.
#
# The package root is "third-party/hexagon-mlir/qcom_hexagon_backend" (not its
# parent), so the CMake package-namespace root must be set to the
# qcom_hexagon_backend/ subdirectory.
set(IREE_PACKAGE_ROOT_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qcom_hexagon_backend")
set(IREE_PACKAGE_ROOT_PREFIX "hexagon_mlir")
set(IREE_HDRS_ROOT_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qcom_hexagon_backend")
# Some tablegen include paths go to the overlay, some go to the real
# hexagon-mlir repo.
set(IREE_COMPILER_TABLEGEN_INCLUDE_DIRS
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qcom_hexagon_backend"
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qcom_hexagon_backend/include"
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../../third-party/hexagon-mlir/qcom_hexagon_backend/include"
)

# The C++ sources have the exact same "qcom_hexagon_backend/include" quote-
# include root requirement as the .td files above.
#  - for sources compiled *within* this overlay tree:
#    use a directory-scoped include_directories()
#  - for external consumers (plugins/compiler/hexagon/{CodeGen,Target}) that
#    only link against the top-level HexagonDialectLibs/HexagonLoweringSupport
#    aggregate targets:
#    qcom_hexagon_backend/CMakeLists.txt below its autogenerated content adds
#    an INTERFACE include that propagates through target_link_libraries()
set(HEXAGON_MLIR_QUOTE_INCLUDE_DIRS
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qcom_hexagon_backend/include"
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../../third-party/hexagon-mlir/qcom_hexagon_backend/include"
)
include_directories(${HEXAGON_MLIR_QUOTE_INCLUDE_DIRS})

add_subdirectory(qcom_hexagon_backend)
